name: Ubis (Asia) Public Company Limited
summary: Ubis (Asia) Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes sealing compounds, lacquers, and coatings used in can production and bottle closure for the food, beverage, and general industries in Thailand and internationally. It serves can manufacturers producing food cans, beverage cans, aerosol cans, and other general cans. Ubis (Asia) Public Company Limited was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
